NEG=-10**9
def gotoh(q,t,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(q),len(t); Mp=[0]+[NEG]*m; Xp=[NEG]*(m+1); Yp=[NEG]*(m+1)
    for j in range(1,m+1): Yp[j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    tb=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Mc=[NEG]*(m+1);Xc=[NEG]*(m+1);Yc=[NEG]*(m+1);Xc[0]=go+ge*(i-1)
        row=bytearray(3*(m+1)); qi=q[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a,b,c=Mp[j-1],Xp[j-1],Yp[j-1]
            if a>=b and a>=c: best,k=a,0
            elif b>=c: best,k=b,1
            else: best,k=c,2
            Mc[j]=best+s_(qi,t[j-1]); row[3*j]=k
            a,b=Mp[j]+go,Xp[j]+ge
            if a>=b: Xc[j],row[3*j+1]=a,0
            else: Xc[j],row[3*j+1]=b,1
            a,b=Mc[j-1]+go,Yc[j-1]+ge
            if a>=b: Yc[j],row[3*j+2]=a,0
            else: Yc[j],row[3*j+2]=b,2
        tb.append(row); Mp,Xp,Yp=Mc,Xc,Yc
    st=int(np.argmax([Mp[m],Xp[m],Yp[m]])); i,j=n,m; aq=[];at=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0: aq.append(q[i-1]);at.append(t[j-1]);st=tb[i-1][3*j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: aq.append(q[i-1]);at.append('-');st=tb[i-1][3*j+1];i-=1
        else: aq.append('-');at.append(t[j-1]);st=tb[i-1][3*j+2];j-=1
    while i>0: aq.append(q[i-1]);at.append('-');i-=1
    while j>0: aq.append('-');at.append(t[j-1]);j-=1
    return ''.join(aq[::-1]),''.join(at[::-1])
def parse(t):
    ch={};io=[];seen=set()
    for l in t.splitlines():
        r=l[:6]
        if r in ('ATOM  ','HETATM'):
            if l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
            rn=l[17:20].strip();c=l[21];nu=l[22:27].strip();an=l[12:16].strip()
            try: x,y,z=float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])
            except: continue
            if rn in AA3 and (r=='ATOM  ' or rn=='MSE'):
                k=(c,nu)
                if k not in seen: seen.add(k); ch.setdefault(c,[]).append({'resn':rn,'num':nu,'atoms':{}})
                ch[c][-1]['atoms'][an]=np.array([x,y,z])
            elif r=='HETATM' and rn in ('CA','MG','MN') and an==rn: io.append(np.array([x,y,z]))
    return ch,io
def sqf(r): return ''.join(AA3.get(x['resn'],'X') for x in r)
def sasa(res,N=80):
    i=np.arange(N)+0.5;phi=np.arccos(1-2*i/N);th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
    s=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)]
    co=[];ra=[];ow=[]
    for k,r in enumerate(res):
        for an,x in r['atoms'].items(): co.append(x);ra.append(RAD.get(an[0],1.7)+1.4);ow.append(k)
    co=np.array(co);ra=np.array(ra);ow=np.array(ow);out=np.zeros(len(res))
    for a in range(len(co)):
        p=co[a]+ra[a]*s;d=np.linalg.norm(co[None,:,:]-p[:,None,:],axis=2);d[:,a]=1e9
        out[ow[a]]+=4*np.pi*ra[a]**2*(d>=ra[None,:]).all(axis=1).mean()
    return out
def fasta(a):
    L=requests.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=60).text.splitlines()
    return ''.join(L[1:])

if al and isinstance(al[0],list): al=al[0]
H={}
for h in al: H.setdefault(h['target'][:4].upper(),[]).append(h)
H={k:sorted(v,key=lambda x:x['eval'])[0] for k,v in H.items()}
def boff(cs,ts):
    b=(-1,0,0)
    for o in range(len(cs)):
        if len(cs)-o<min(len(ts),20): break
        m=n=0
        for i,c in enumerate(ts):
            k=o+i
            if k>=len(cs): break
            n+=1;m+=(cs[k]==c)
        if m>b[0]: b=(m,o,n)
    return b
def kab(P,Q):
    Hm=(P-P.mean(0)).T@(Q-Q.mean(0));U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(Hm)
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T
    return R,Q.mean(0)-R@P.mean(0)
sites=[]
for pid in ['7JOF','1A25','1W15','5A52']:
    h=H.get(pid)
    if not h: continue
    ch,io=parse(requests.get(f'https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb',timeout=90).text)
    ts=h['tSeq']; bc=None;bf=-1
    for c,res in ch.items():
        cs=sqf(res);m,o,n=boff(cs,ts)
        if n>=min(len(ts),30) and m/max(1,n)>bf: bf=m/max(1,n);bc=(c,o)
    if not bc: continue
    c,o=bc;tres=ch[c];qa,ta=h['qAln'],h['dbAln'];qi=h['qStartPos']-1;ti=h['dbStartPos']-1
    P=[];Q=[]
    for a,b in zip(qa,ta):
        if a!='-' and b!='-':
            k=o+ti

        if a!='-': qi+=1
        if b!='-': ti+=1
    P=np.array(P);Q=np.array(Q); idx=np.arange(len(P))
    for _ in range(5):
        R,t=kab(P[idx],Q[idx]);d=np.linalg.norm((P@R.T+t)-Q,axis=1);idx=np.where(d<4)[0]
        if len(idx)<15: break

SITE=sites[keep].mean(0)

 'S. purpuratus':'A0A7M7RA54','Schistosoma':'G4LXE7','Drosophila':'M9MRD5','C. elegans':'Q9N423',
 'Trichoplax':'B3RKM0','Chlamydomonas':'A8IWR1','Naegleria':'D2V2P0','Trypanosoma':'Q387L3',
